# MedSetu — by Naitik Library

> MedSetu is a free FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) practice website published by Naitik Library, a study hall for medical students in Gautam Nagar, New Delhi, founded by Naitik Gaur. It offers previous-year FMGE papers as full mock tests, a 30-test grand test series, subject-wise tests and a question bank of 13,934 questions — every question with an explanation, and a detailed eight-part analysis after every test. No sign-up, no accounts, no data collected: a student's name and answers never leave their own browser.

Key facts about the FMGE (per the NBEMS information bulletin): 300 multiple-choice questions in two parts of 150; +1 per correct answer; no negative marking; pass mark 150 of 300. NBEMS never releases official FMGE papers or answer keys, so MedSetu's papers are recall-based editions and are labelled as such.

## Practice

- [PYP Tests — FMGE previous-year papers as mock tests](https://med-setu.netlify.app/papers/): 12 papers, December 2020 to June 2026, each a full 300 questions in the real two-part exam manner.
- [MedSetu Test Series](https://med-setu.netlify.app/tests/): 30 grand tests of 300 questions each — a full FMGE paper in two parts of 150, in the official NBEMS subject proportions — drawn from previous-year papers and the question bank; every question carries a learning point; no question repeats across the series.
- [Subject-wise Tests](https://med-setu.netlify.app/subjects/): 16 subjects, 30 tests, one subject at a time, measured against the 50% FMGE pass proportion.
- [Question Bank](https://med-setu.netlify.app/qbank/): 13,934 questions across all 19 FMGE subjects, organised by topic, with Practice mode, Exam mode, My Mistakes and Bookmarks.

## Revise

- [Short Notes](https://med-setu.netlify.app/notes/): rapid-revision notes for all 19 FMGE subjects, built from previous-year papers — high-yield topics as crisp facts, comparison tables, exam traps, night-before golden points and a mind map per subject. Read online only; not downloadable.
- [Flashcards](https://med-setu.netlify.app/flashcards/): 950 flashcards (50 per subject) for active recall — flip, sort into "got it" and "still learning", and re-run the learning pile. Nothing is stored; progress lives only in the open tab.

## Blog

- [MedSetu Blog](https://med-setu.netlify.app/blog/): 150 free guides for medical students — FMGE preparation strategy, subject-wise study guides, book guides, notes and revision methods, MBBS abroad and colleges, new medical research explained, exam skills and mindset, careers after FMGE/MBBS, and clinical skills.
